basis_dislocation.finding: Extreme basis dislocation during cascade; perpetual traded at deep discount to spot index.

open_interest_deleveraging.finding: Aggressive open interest liquidation and contraction prior to spot price stabilization.

funding_rate_response.finding: Funding rate plunged deeply negative reflecting acute short crowding.

futures_taker_flow.finding: Severe negative taker imbalance (aggressive market sell orders on perpetual) preceded local bottom.

top_trader_positioning.finding: Top traders rapidly reduced net long exposure ahead of final cascade leg.

causal_assessment: Derivatives data revealed massive leveraged positioning liquidation and aggressive taker selling that was NOT visible in spot price alone.
